newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: LOCAL COUNCILS OWE S.AFRICA'S ESKOM 1.3 BLN RAND.
newsitem.headline: LOCAL COUNCILS OWE S.AFRICA'S ESKOM 1.3 BLN RAND.

text.p: Local authorities owed South Africa's Eskom power utility 1.3 billion rand, including interest, at the end of last year, Public Enterprises Minister Stella Sigcau said on Thursday.
She said in a written reply to a question in parliament that the figure, as at December 31, compared with 810 million rand at the end of 1994. The debts had accumulated since September 1990.
Sigcau said Eskom had installed about 1.5 million pre-paid meters but about one third of them were being by-passed by customers.
She said Eskom was negotiating with local authorities that were in arrears, resulting in agreement "in the majority of cases" on a debt payment schedule.
